description:
Metadata describing a single acquisition run.

A *run* is a contiguous period during which the ESP32 collects sensor
data from the attached hardware.  This record is written once at the
start of each run and is referenced by all sample and feature records
via ``run_id``.

Nominal frequency fields capture the *intended* acquisition rate, not
any measured or verified throughput.

device_id.description: Unique identifier of the ESP32 device.
device_id.title: Device Id

nominal_accel_hz.description: Design-target sampling rate for the MPU6050 accelerometer and ACS712 current sensor, in Hz.  This is an engineering target, not a verified acquisition rate.
nominal_accel_hz.title: Nominal Accel Hz

nominal_current_hz.description: Design-target sampling rate for the ACS712 current sensor, in Hz.  This is an engineering target, not a verified rate.
nominal_current_hz.title: Nominal Current Hz

nominal_environment_interval_s.description: Design-target interval between DHT11 ambient readings, in seconds.  DHT11 is a slow sensor; values more frequent than ~0.5 s are not physically meaningful.
nominal_environment_interval_s.title: Nominal Environment Interval S

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this acquisition run.  Typically a UUID or a timestamp-based token.
run_id.title: Run Id

started_at_utc.description: UTC timestamp at which data acquisition began.  Must be timezone-aware (tzinfo=UTC).
started_at_utc.title: Started At Utc

title: RunMetadata
